description: This file handles mass editing of records in the PriceBooks module for the vtiger CRM system. It retrieves record IDs, checks permissions, updates fields with submitted data, and redirects back to a list view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity with method getInstance to instantiate an entity based on module.

methods.name: retrieve_entity_info
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific entity record and populates the focus object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists the current focus object with updated fields.
